integrity: Self-contained analytic proof with exact-rational reproducibility checker; no claim of independent mathematical audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Sharpness and extremizers proved only for integer Fourier coefficients of the uniform twenty-map Menger sponge measure. Not a classification of noninteger frequencies, nonuniform weights, or the third coefficient level. Literature coverage is bounded.
title: The first two integer Fourier levels of the uniform Menger sponge measure
